descricao: Somente o comentário do campo descricao muda; o SELECT vigente permanece válido

verificacoes.sql:
SELECT d.description AS comentario FROM pg_catalog.pg_description d
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class c ON c.oid=d.objoid
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=c.oid AND a.attnum=d.objsubid
WHERE n.nspname='ws4_demo' AND c.relname='teste_deploy' AND a.attname='descricao';
